summary: Analysts’ Opinions Are Mixed on These Technology Stocks: Micron (MU) and nCino (NCNO) The Globe and Mail
body:
Companies in the Technology sector have received a lot of coverage today as analysts weigh in on Micron (MU) and nCino (NCNO).

Cantor Fitzgerald analyst C J Muse maintained a Buy rating on Micron today and set a price target of $700.00. The company’s shares closed last Tuesday at $337.84.

According to TipRanks.com, Muse is a top 25 analyst with an average return of 59.7% and a 69.8% success rate. Muse covers the Technology sector, focusing on stocks such as GlobalFoundries Inc, Applied Materials, and Western Digital. ;'>

Currently, the analyst consensus on Micron is a Strong Buy with an average price target of $533.40, representing a 65.8% upside. In a report issued on March 18, Bernstein also maintained a Buy rating on the stock with a $510.00 price target.

See today’s best-performing stocks on TipRanks >>

J.P. Morgan analyst Ella Smith maintained a Hold rating on nCino today and set a price target of $16.00. The company’s shares closed last Tuesday at $14.98.

According to TipRanks.com, Smith has 0 stars on 0-5 stars ranking scale with an average return of -12.5% and a 26.9% success rate. Smith covers the Technology sector, focusing on stocks such as Alkami Technology, Q2 Holdings, and Alarm. ;'>

The word on The Street in general, suggests a Moderate Buy analyst consensus rating for nCino with a $22.50 average price target, implying a 54.0% upside from current levels. In a report issued on March 25, BTIG also maintained a Hold rating on the stock.
